source_snapshot.criteria: BIOS is flashed successfully and the post-flash version is correct.
source_snapshot.script: Private afuefi_reflash path; 10 attended and 30 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes the AMI image/tool, uninterrupted flash, AC transition and version readback, but does not establish why a same-version rewrite is required or how retained state is distinguished from silent corruption.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; requires exact platform/current and image/tool identity, signed provenance and compatibility, owner-approved reflash purpose, stable power, recovery and before/after state evidence.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally aligned on the flash sequence and risk, but a post-boot version string alone cannot prove that every intended region was rewritten or that configuration and security state survived.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves the exact command and activation while adding reflash-purpose, image provenance, compatibility, baseline and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate; adjacent upgrade, downgrade and repeated-flash rows were kept as separate intent and evidence paths.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Same-version firmware writing remains destructive and must be purpose-bound, explicitly approved and evidenced without undocumented switches or automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Reflash the verified platform with the specifically approved BIOS image, activate it through the required AC transition and prove the intended firmware was rewritten while the expected firmware, configuration, security and device state remains coherent.
original_method: Identify the board, current firmware and reflash purpose, authenticate the same approved image and AMI tool, preserve pre-state, run the source command once under stable power, perform the approved AC transition, then validate BIOS/ME identity, configuration, secure-boot/TPM, boot, devices and logs.
manual_activity: The firmware owner authorizes the same-version rewrite and its intended repaired or refreshed scope; an operator confirms power integrity, supervises the flash and AC transition, and controls any crisis-recovery procedure.
required_inputs: Board PN/SKU/revision, CPU family and current BIOS/ME/security state
Exact approved BIOS release and the reason for same-version reflash
Image checksum/signature/provenance, compatibility and release notes
Supported afuefix64.efi/EFI environment and approved `/P /B /N /ME` meaning
Expected preservation or reset behavior for NVRAM, secure boot, TPM, measured boot and boot order
Saved configuration, stable UPS/AC, activation timing, OOB console and recovery image/process
safety_requirements: Archive complete firmware, policy, configuration, TPM/boot, device and event baseline before any clear
Do not reflash without explicit purpose, target-image authorization and verified signed provenance
Never add undocumented switches or use the rewrite to bypass signature or rollback policy
Do not interrupt the AMI operation or AC-cycle before documented completion
Stop on signature mismatch, component incompatibility, unexpected AMI response or unapproved state reset
After rejection or boot failure, preserve evidence and invoke only the approved recovery path; no blind retry
Verify all intended retained and reset state before returning the SUT
agent_execution_scope: Validate target identity, same-version relation, reflash purpose, image/tool authenticity and approval
Stage the exact source command without execution and capture complete pre-state
After explicit approval, execute once while retaining full status
Observe the approved AC/boot lifecycle through protected console/OOB
Collect BIOS/ME, configuration, secure-boot/TPM, device, health and event post-state
Report the before/after comparison without retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the reflash purpose, target image, intended rewritten regions and retained/reset state
Ensure stable power and supervise the flash/activation
Decide recovery on rejection, partial rewrite or boot/configuration failure
Review firmware and platform-state evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The AMI reflash outline and version check match the source, but `dmidecode` cannot prove that the intended regions were rewritten or that NVRAM, ME and security state are coherent, and the proposal omits purpose-specific recovery evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after purpose and image authorization, run `afuefix64.efi <approved-reflash-image> /P /B /N /ME` once in the verified supported EFI environment; retain complete output and do not add undocumented switches or retry automatically.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Reflash intent, exact component switches, AC transition, post-flash version check, private script reference and 10/30-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: AUTHORIZED REFLASH PURPOSE AND RECOVERY PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the rewrite to a documented purpose and intended region scope, preserve platform state, flash once under stable power, activate as specified, then compare firmware, configuration, security and device state against the approved preservation/reset matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds same-version purpose, region-scope, signed provenance, retained-state oracle and recovery decisions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An unchanged BIOS version string cannot distinguish a complete intended rewrite from a skipped, partial or wrong-region operation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A same-version image can still reset NVRAM, alter ME or boot/security state, or fail between regions even though the displayed BIOS version remains unchanged.

project_override_considerations: If the Project intends only selected firmware regions to be rewritten, it must approve the vendor-supported reduced command and explicitly record uncovered regions. Undocumented flags or a version-only oracle are not acceptable substitutes.
expected_evidence: Board/current and target firmware identity, same-version reflash purpose, authorization and intended region scope
Image hash/signature/provenance, AMI tool/EFI identity and approved exact command
Complete pre-reflash configuration, BIOS/ME, secure-boot/TPM, boot, device and event baseline
Raw AMI output/status and uninterrupted flash evidence
Approved AC transition, boot milestones and exact post-state firmware readings
Preserved/reset state matrix, device/event comparison, recovery record if applicable and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, command, activation and Criteria consistently define an AMI BIOS reflash. The specific image, purpose and state-preservation oracle are required owner inputs rather than contradictory source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A compatible signed image, approved reflash purpose and recovery procedure are finite inputs. The review can safely classify the operation while prohibiting execution until they are supplied.

review_improvement: Adds same-version rewrite purpose, intended-region and retained-state proof to DeepSeek's generic flash outline and prevents an unchanged version string from serving as the sole success evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A same-version string can remain constant after a skipped or partial multi-region write and after NVRAM or ME state changes. Therefore correctness depends on the authorized rewrite scope plus before/after configuration, security and component evidence, not on version equality alone.
